column2: Which earlier rules did the CCS (Pension) Rules 2021 replace, and under which rule is the repeal with savings?
column3:
Rule: The 2021 Rules replaced the CCS (Pension) Rules 1972; repeal-with-savings sits in the repeal rule (pending/old cases continue under savings clauses).

Hinglish: 1972 wale Rules gaye, 2021 wale aaye — par purane cases repeal ke savings se bachte hain.

Ref: Rule 1; Rule 87

column3:
Rule: 2022 amendment in force on publication; rewrote proceedings authorities, added 8the appellate clause, reversed Expl.1, fixed the gratuity-nomination rule, renumbered the payment rule.

Hinglish: 2022 wala amendment proceedings ka poora rewrite — teen authorities + appeal structure.

column3:
Rule: Cl.1: in force after 120 days from 16.07.2024 (mid-Nov 2024 — portals cite compassionate-allowance/PSU-counting/probation/civil-return Nov; VERIFY Gazette before quoting exact date).

column2: The Third Amendment{{c1::G.S.R. 340(E)}}dated{{c2::22.05.2025}}substituted the PSU-absorption rule{{c3::PSU-absorption}}and came into force{{c4::on publication, 22.05.2025}}.
column3:
Rule: PSU dismissal/removal after absorption forfeits Govt-service retirement benefits too; retrenchment only triggers Ministry review.

Hinglish: 2025 amendment — PSU me nikaale gaye to Sarkari pension bhi gayi; lagu publication wale din se.

Ref: G.S.R. 340(E); Rule 37

column2: The definition rule applies the 2021 Rules to Government servants appointed{{c1::on or before 31.12.2003}}(pre-2004 appointees).
column3:
Rule: Cut-off is appointment date 31.12.2003; post-31.12.2003 joiners fall under NPS Rules (Cut-off is appointment date 31.12.2003; post-31.12.2003 joiners fall under NPS Rules (subject to Explanations).

Hinglish: 31.12.2003 tak appointed = pension rules; uske baad = NPS (kuch exceptions ke saath).

Trap: Date is 31.12.2003, not 01.01.2004.

Ref: Rule ule 2 main para; Rule 2

column2: The definition rule's sub-rule (a) excludes{{c1::Railway servants}}from the CCS (Pension) Rules 2021.
column3:
Rule: Railway staff have their own pension rules.

Hinglish: Railway wale isme nahi — unke apne rules hain.

Ref: Rule 2(a)
column5: CCS_Pension Rule_02_a Exclusion CCS_Pension::Rule_02 Priority::High CCS_Pension::Rule_02_a

column2: The definition rule's sub-rule (b) excludes persons in{{c1::casual and daily-rated}}employment.
column3:
Rule: Casual/daily-rated workers are outside the Rules (contrast: temporary-status regularised service counts 50% under the temporary-status rule).

Hinglish: Casual/daily-rated = bahar; par regularised temporary-status ka 50% service temporary-status me gina jaata hai.

Ref: Rule 2(b); Rule 15
column5: CCS_Pension Rule_02_b Exclusion CCS_Pension::Rule_02 Priority::High CCS_Pension::Rule_02_b

column2: The definition rule's sub-rule (c) excludes persons paid from{{c1::contingencies}}.
column3:
Rule: Contingency-paid establishment is not pensionable under these Rules.

Hinglish: Contingencies se salary pane wale bahar.

Ref: Rule 2(c)
column5: CCS_Pension Rule_02_c Exclusion CCS_Pension::Rule_02 Priority::High CCS_Pension::Rule_02_c

column2: The definition rule's sub-rule (d) excludes persons under the{{c1::Contributory Provident Fund (CPF)}}scheme.
column3:
Rule: CPF-covered staff stay under CPF (contrast the contract-service rule's sub-rule: CPF Govt contribution refunded on counting service).

Hinglish: CPF wale bahar — pension scheme wale andar.

Ref: Rule 2(d); Rule 18(ii); Rule 2(ii)
column5: CCS_Pension Rule_02_d Exclusion CCS_Pension::Rule_02 Priority::High CCS_Pension::Rule_02_d

column2: The definition rule's sub-rule (e) excludes members of the{{c1::All India Services (AIS)}}.
column3:
Rule: AIS (IAS/IPS/IFoS) have separate pension regulations.

Hinglish: IAS/IPS/IFoS bahar — unke apne AIS pension rules.

Ref: Rule 2(e)
column5: CCS_Pension Rule_02_e Exclusion CCS_Pension::Rule_02 Priority::High CCS_Pension::Rule_02_e

column2: The definition rule's sub-rule (f) excludes persons{{c1::locally recruited for service abroad / foreign local recruits}}.
column3:
Rule: Foreign local recruits are excluded.

Hinglish: Videsh me locally bharti — bahar.

Ref: Rule 2(f)
column5: CCS_Pension Rule_02_f Exclusion CCS_Pension::Rule_02 Priority::High CCS_Pension::Rule_02_f

column2: The definition rule's sub-rule (g) excludes persons engaged on{{c1::contract}}, UNLESS{{c2::the contract provides otherwise}}.
column3:
Rule: Contract staff are out — but a contract clause can pull them in; this is the ONLY definition exclusion with an in-built exception.

Hinglish: Contract wale bahar, LEKIN contract me likha ho to andar — yahi ek exception hai.

Trap: 'UNLESS contract provides otherwise' attaches ONLY to clause.

Ref: Rule 2(g); Rule 2
column5: CCS_Pension Rule_02_g Exclusion Exception CCS_Pension::Rule_02 Priority::Critical CCS_Pension::Rule_02_g

column2: The definition rule's sub-rule (h) excludes persons whose pension is regulated by the{{c1::Constitution or any other law}}.
column3:
Rule: Catch-all for separately-governed functionaries (e.g., constitutional posts with own pension law).

Hinglish: Jinki pension Constitution/kisi aur kanoon se chalti hai — ve bahar.

Ref: Rule 2(h)
column5: CCS_Pension Rule_02_h Exclusion CCS_Pension::Rule_02 Priority::High CCS_Pension::Rule_02_h

column2: Recite all 8 definition exclusions all 8 clauses in order.
column3:
Rule: Railway casual/daily-rated contingencies CPF AIS foreign local recruit contract (unless contract provides otherwise) Constitution/other law.

Hinglish: Railway, Casual, Contingency, CPF, AIS, Foreign-local, Contract, Constitution — aath bahar.

Mnemonic: Ra-Ca-Co-C-A-Fo-Co-Co = 'Railway Casual Contingency CPF AIS Foreign Contract Constitution'.

Ref: Rule 2(a)-(h); Rule 2; Rule 2(a); Rule 2(b); Rule 2(c); Rule 2(d); Rule 2(e); Rule 2(f); Rule 2(g); Rule 2(h)
column5: CCS_Pension Rule_02 Exclusion Mnemonic Synthesis CCS_Pension::Rule_02 Priority::High

column2: The definition rule's Explanation 2 deals with persons under a{{c1::different pension scheme / State Government / Autonomous Body}}.
column3:
Rule: Persons already governed elsewhere (other scheme, State, autonomous body) are not double-covered automatically.

Hinglish: Jo pehle se kahin aur covered hai, ve auto-cover nahi honge.

Ref: Rule 2 Expl.2; Rule 2
column5: CCS_Pension Rule_02_Exp2 Explanation CCS_Pension::Rule_02 Priority::Medium CCS_Pension::Rule_02_Exp2

column2: The definition rule's Explanation 3 is the{{c1::special/general order (catch-all)}}Explanation.
column3:
Rule: Government may extend/clarify coverage by special or general order.

Hinglish: Sarkar order nikaal kar coverage tay kar sakti hai — catch-all.

Ref: Rule 2 Expl.3; Rule 2
column5: CCS_Pension Rule_02_Exp3 Explanation CCS_Pension::Rule_02 Priority::Medium CCS_Pension::Rule_02_Exp3

column2: The definition rule's Explanation 4 links{{c1::temporary status}}service to the temporary-status rule{{c2::temporary-status}}at{{c3::family-pension per cent}}counting.
column3:
Rule: Temporary-status (regularised casual labour) service counts 50% under the temporary-status rule.

Hinglish: Temporary-status wala aadha service paayega — the temporary-status rule.

Ref: Rule 2 Expl.4; Rule 15; Rule 2; Rule 50

column2: On NPS death/invalidation, {{c1::invalid pension + family pension}} is payable IF {{c2::option exercised under the NPS Implementation Rules}} OR {{c3::default favours these rules}}.
column3:
Rule: Post-2003 NPS servants get invalid/family-pension benefits on NPS option or favourable default. Secondary: default = old-scheme if death <15y service (press summary of NPS Rules — VERIFY full text); gratuity OM 7/5/2012; UPS death gratuity from 18.06.2025.

Hinglish: NPS-vikalp-ya-chook — pension-sahara.

Ref: Rule 2 Expl (5); NPS Implementation Rules, Rule 10; Rule 39; Rule 50
column5: CCS_Pension Rule_02_Exp5 NPS Family_Pension CCS_Pension::Rule_02 Priority::High CCS_Pension::Rule_02_Exp5

column2: The definition rule's Explanation 6 covers retirement in a{{c1::temporary capacity}}under the CCS (Temporary Service) the civil-return rule{{c2::civil-return}}.
column3:
Rule: Temporary-capacity retirees are dealt with under the 1965 Temporary Service Rules linkage.

Hinglish: Temporary capacity me retire — 1965 Rules wala rasta.

Ref: Rule 2 Expl.6; Rule 19; Rule 2
column5: CCS_Pension Rule_02_Exp6 Explanation CCS_Pension::Rule_02 Priority::Medium CCS_Pension::Rule_02_Exp6

column2: Why does definition say 'these rules shall ALSO APPLY TO' instead of 'deemed appointed on or before 31.12.2003'?
column3:
Rule: Extension-by-application preserves the actual appointment date (no legal fiction of deemed appointment); effects like seniority/pay stay untouched.

Hinglish: 'Apply' ka matlab sirf pension-cover badha; appointment date wahi — deemed fiction nahi.

Trap: Do not equate 'also apply to' with deemed pre-2004 appointment.

Ref: Rule 2 drafting note; Rule 2

column2: {{c1::Accounts Officer}}means the officer who maintains the{{c2::accounts / authorises pension}}of the Government servant.
column3:
Rule: AO = authority maintaining accounts and authorising pension/family pension/gratuity (audits Form 7/11, issues PPO).

Hinglish: Accounts Officer = hisaab rakhne + PPO nikaalne wala adhikari.

Ref: Rule 3(1)(a); Rule 3(1)
column5: CCS_Pension Rule_03_1_a Definition CCS_Pension::Rule_03 Priority::High CCS_Pension::Rule_03_1_a

column2: {{c1::Allottee}}means the Government servant to whom{{c2::Government accommodation}}is allotted.
column3:
Rule: Allottee status drives Rules dues/withholding/death-dues dues machinery and NDC before gratuity release.

Hinglish: Sarkari makaan mila = allottee; NDC bina gratuity ka 10% atakta hai.

Ref: Rule 3(1)(b); Rule 3(1); Rule 67; Rule 68; Rule 77
column5: CCS_Pension Rule_03_1_b Definition CCS_Pension::Rule_03 Priority::High CCS_Pension::Rule_03_1_b

column2: {{c1::Average emoluments}}means average of emoluments of the{{c2::last 10 months}}(the average-emoluments rule).
column3:
Rule: 10-month average; pension uses emoluments OR average, whichever more beneficial (the average-emoluments rule vs 44).

Hinglish: Aakhri 10 mahine ka average — jo bada (emoluments ya average) wahi pension ka base.

Ref: Rule 3(1)(c); Rule 32; Rule 3(1)
column5: CCS_Pension Rule_03_1_c Definition Average_Emoluments CCS_Pension::Rule_03 Priority::High CCS_Pension::Rule_03_1_c

column2: {{c1::Bhavishya}}is the{{c2::online pension processing}}system.
column3:
Rule: Default pension-case platform with e-HRMS under the Bhavishya rule (e-HRMS superannuation only; others Bhavishya).

Hinglish: Bhavishya = pension ka online portal; e-HRMS sirf superannuation ke liye.

Ref: Rule 3(1)(d); Rule 53; Rule 3(1)
column5: CCS_Pension Rule_03_1_d Definition CCS_Pension::Rule_03 Priority::High CCS_Pension::Rule_03_1_d

column2: {{c1::Child}}— state the definition and its pension significance.
column3:
Rule: Child includes categories eligible under the family-pension rule's sub-rule (son <25 unmarried not earning; daughter unmarried/widowed/divorced not earning; disabled child no age bar) — birth order + twins + divorce-filing rules attach.

Hinglish: Baccha = beta <25, beti (unmarried/widow/divorced), disabled (umar ki seema nahi).

Ref: Rule 3(1)(e); Rule 50(9); Rule 3(1); Rule 3(9)
column5: CCS_Pension Rule_03_1_e Definition Family_Pension CCS_Pension::Rule_03 Priority::High CCS_Pension::Rule_03_1_e

column2: {{c1::Dearness Relief}}is relief on{{c2::pension/family pension}}to neutralise{{c3::price rise}}, granted under the DR rule{{c4::DR}}('may be granted').
column3:
Rule: DR is NOT part of pension/family pension definitions (the interpretation rule's sub-rule (t)(i)); current 60% w.e.f. 01.01.2026 — VOLATILE.

Hinglish: DR = mehangaai raahat, pension ka hissa NAHI; abhi 60% — badalta rehta hai.

Last verified: 2026-09-20

Ref: Rule 3(1)(f); Rule 52; Rule 3(1); Rules 3(t), 3(i)
column5: CCS_Pension Rule_03_1_f Definition Dearness_Relief CCS_Pension::Rule_03 Priority::Critical CCS_Pension::Rule_03_1_f

column2: {{c1::Defence Service}}≠{{c2::Armed Forces}}— state the distinction.
column3:
Rule: Defence Service is the defined service category; do not casually equate with Armed Forces of the Union (exam trap).

Hinglish: Defence Service aur Armed Forces ek nahi — shabdon ka jaal hai.

Ref: Rule 3(1)(g); Rule 3(1)
column5: CCS_Pension Rule_03_1_g Definition Exam_Trap CCS_Pension::Rule_03 Priority::High CCS_Pension::Rule_03_1_g

column2: {{c1::Emoluments}}means{{c2::basic pay per}}(+ NPA for medical officers; stagnation increment counts).
column3:
Rule: emoluments timing: pay at retirement/death; +DA only for gratuity computation under the gratuity rule's sub-rule.

Hinglish: Emoluments = basic pay (+NPA); gratuity me DA judta hai, pension me nahi.

Ref: Rule 3(1)(h); Rule 31; Rule 3(1); FR 9(21)(a)(i); Rule 45(6); Rule 3(6)
column5: CCS_Pension Rule_03_1_h Definition Emoluments CCS_Pension::Rule_03 Priority::Critical CCS_Pension::Rule_03_1_h

column2: {{c1::Family Pension}}means pension payable to{{c2::family}}under the family-pension rule{{c3::family-pension}}, and it{{c4::excludes Dearness Relief}}.
column3:
Rule: Like Pension, the definition excludes DR (DR is granted separately under the DR rule).

Hinglish: Family pension = parivaar ko family-pension me; DR isme shamil NAHI.

Ref: Rule 3(1)(i); Rule 50; Rule 3(1); Rule 52
column5: CCS_Pension Rule_03_1_i Definition Family_Pension CCS_Pension::Rule_03 Priority::Critical CCS_Pension::Rule_03_1_i

column2: {{c1::Foreign Service}}means service in which a Government servant receives pay from{{c2::other than Central revenues}}(e.g., PSU/autonomous body/State/foreign).
column3:
Rule: Drives absorption machinery (deemed deputation, foreign service terms, no deputation allowance).

Hinglish: Bahar ki naukri jiska paisa Kendra se na aaye = foreign service.

Ref: Rule 3(1)(j); Rule 3(1); Rule 35; Rule 38
column5: CCS_Pension Rule_03_1_j Definition Deputation CCS_Pension::Rule_03 Priority::High CCS_Pension::Rule_03_1_j

column2: What is the difference between 'Form' [the interpretation rule's sub-rule (1)(k)] and 'Format' [the interpretation rule's sub-rule (1)(l)]?
column3:
Rule: (k) Form = a form appended to these rules (statutory application — servant/claimant fills: Forms 1–13); (l) Format = a format appended (office template/undertaking/covering letter: Formats 1–13).

Hinglish: Form = karmchari/claimant bharta hai; Format = daftar ka template/letter. Dono appended hain, kaam alag.

Trap: Synonyms mat samjho — 2024 me 9 forms Form 6-A me merge hue.

Ref: Rule 3(1)(k), 3(1)(l); Rule 3(1)
column5: CCS_Pension Rule_03_1_k Rule_03_1_l Definition Form Format Exam_Trap CCS_Pension::Rule_03 Priority::Critical CCS_Pension::Rule_03_1_k

column2: {{c1::Government}}means the{{c2::Central Government}}unless context otherwise requires.
column3:
Rule: Default Government = Central Government (State contexts flagged expressly, e.g., the State-transfer rule).

Hinglish: 'Government' bole to Kendra Sarkar — Rajya ka zikr alag se hota hai.

Ref: Rule 3(1)(m); Rule 3(1); Rule 13
column5: CCS_Pension Rule_03_1_m Definition CCS_Pension::Rule_03 Priority::Medium CCS_Pension::Rule_03_1_m

column2: {{c1::Government dues}}— which two Explanation baskets exist under the dues rule?
column3:
Rule: accommodation dues (licence fee arrears, damages, electricity/water/PNG) other dues (advances, overpayments, income tax). HoO ascertains/assesses; adjusted from gratuity.

Hinglish: Sarkari makaan ke + baaki (advance/overpayment/tax) — HoO vasoolta hai gratuity se.

Ref: Rule 3(1)(n); Rule 67; Rule 3(1); Rule 3(a); Rule 3(b)
column5: CCS_Pension Rule_03_1_n Definition Government_Dues CCS_Pension::Rule_03 Priority::High CCS_Pension::Rule_03_1_n

column2: 'Gratuity' includes which 3 types?
column3:
Rule: Definition has 3 LIMBS — (i) service retirement OR death (the gratuity rule's sub-rule ) = ONE limb, TWO live types residuary (the gratuity rule's sub-rule ). Limbs = 3, live types = 4 (service, retirement, death, residuary).

Hinglish: Teen-anga-chaar-prakaar.

Ref: Rule 3(1)(o); Rule 3(1); Rule 44; Rule 45(1); Rule 45(3); Rule 3(ii); Rule 3(iii); Rule 3(3)
column5: CCS_Pension Rule_03_1_o Definition Gratuity CCS_Pension::Rule_03 Priority::Critical CCS_Pension::Rule_03_1_o

column2: Interpretation vs Provision: Head of Department ≠ Head of Office — state the distinction.
column3:
Rule: HoD = department head (lists under the retirement-list rule, sanctions); HoO = office head doing pension-case work (verification, Forms, forwarding, provisional sanction). Head of Office ≠ senior-most officer present.

Hinglish: HoD = vibhaag ka mukhiya; HoO = pension-file chalane wala — sabse senior vyakti nahi.

Ref: Rule 3(1)(p), 3(1)(q); Rule 3(1); Rule 54
column5: CCS_Pension Rule_03_1_p Rule_03_1_q Definition Exam_Trap CCS_Pension::Rule_03 Priority::High CCS_Pension::Rule_03_1_p

column2: {{c1::Local Fund administered by Government}}— why does it matter?
column3:
Rule: Service paid from a Govt-administered Local Fund can still be qualifying service (the paid-service rule Explanation) — funding source test.

Hinglish: Local Fund se salary mile tab bhi service gin sakti hai — paid-service dekho.

Ref: Rule 3(1)(r); Rule 12; Rule 3(1)
column5: CCS_Pension Rule_03_1_r Definition CCS_Pension::Rule_03 Priority::Medium CCS_Pension::Rule_03_1_r

column2: {{c1::Minor}}means a person below{{c2::18 years}}— pension relevance?
column3:
Rule: Minor nominees/claimants act through guardians (gratuity-nomination alternate nominee; family-pension guardian; pensioner-death remarriage guardianship).

Hinglish: 18 se kam = minor; guardian ke through kaam hota hai.

Ref: Rule 3(1)(s); Rule 3(1); Rule 46; Rule 50(9); Rule 79(4)
column5: CCS_Pension Rule_03_1_s Definition CCS_Pension::Rule_03 Priority::Medium CCS_Pension::Rule_03_1_s

column2: {{c1::Pension}}{{c2::excludes}}Dearness Relief — and{{c1::Family Pension}}also{{c2::excludes}}DR. Why tested together?
column3:
Rule: BOTH definitions exclude DR; DR is granted separately under the DR rule ('may be granted'). Classic exam trap: Pension vs Family Pension differ in PAYEE (servant vs family), not in DR treatment.

Hinglish: Dono me DR bahar; farq sirf paane wale ka — karmchari ya parivaar.

Ref: Rule 3(1)(t); Rule 3(1)(i); Rule 52; Rule 3(1)
column5: CCS_Pension Rule_03_1_t Definition Exam_Trap CCS_Pension::Rule_03 Priority::Critical CCS_Pension::Rule_03_1_t

column2: {{c1::Pension Payment Order (PPO)}}is the{{c2::authorisation}}issued by the{{c3::Accounts Officer}}for{{c4::pension/family pension/gratuity}}payment.
column3:
Rule: PPO + Format 9 undertaking → CPAO Special Seal (21 days for superannuation retirement track, 10 days for death/family pension track) → PDA disburses (15 days) — authorisation chain.

Hinglish: PPO = AO ka payment order; uske baad CPAO seal, phir PDA payment.

Ref: Rule 3(1)(v); Rule 80; Rule 3(1)
column5: CCS_Pension Rule_03_1_v Definition CCS_Pension::Rule_03 Priority::High CCS_Pension::Rule_03_1_v

column2: {{c1::Qualifying Service}}means service that{{c2::counts for pension}}under Chapter{{c3::III}}.
column3:
Rule: QS thresholds: 1y (family pension gateway), 5y (gratuity), 10y (pension), 18y (verification clock), 20y (VR), 30y (premature).

Hinglish: QS = pension ke kaam ki service; 1-5-10-18-20-30 yaad rakho.

Ref: Rule 3(1)(w); Rules 11-30; Rule 3(1)
column5: CCS_Pension Rule_03_1_w Definition Qualifying_Service CCS_Pension::Rule_03 Priority::Critical CCS_Pension::Rule_03_1_w

column2: {{c1::Retirement Benefits}}includes{{c2::pension/family pension/gratuity}}taken together.
column3:
Rule: Umbrella term used in withholding, forfeiture (the PSU-absorption rule's sub-rule (29)), absorption options.

Hinglish: Retirement benefits = pension + gratuity sab kuch ek saath.

Ref: Rule 3(1)(x); Rule 3(1); Rule 37(29)(c); Rule 7; Rule 8; Rule 3(c)
column5: CCS_Pension Rule_03_1_x Definition CCS_Pension::Rule_03 Priority::Medium CCS_Pension::Rule_03_1_x

column2: {{c1::Service Book}}— why is it the backbone of Chapters III, X, XI?
column3:
Rule: Definite entries prove QS (leave, suspension, condonation, nomination, calendar/record-verification/FP-settlement verification); unverified entries have deemed-verified fallbacks.

Hinglish: Service Book = sabooton ki kitaab; entry nahi to deeming provisions bachati hain.

Ref: Rule 3(1)(y); Rule 3(1); Rule 21; Rule 23; Rule 28; Rule 46; Rule 73; Rule 57; Rule 72
column5: CCS_Pension Rule_03_1_y Definition CCS_Pension::Rule_03 Priority::High CCS_Pension::Rule_03_1_y

column2: {{c1::Treasury}}{{c2::includes a Sub-Treasury}}.
column3:
Rule: Express inclusive definition — Sub-Treasury is Treasury for payment machinery (the satellite-application rule Treasury Rules).

Hinglish: Treasury bole to Sub-Treasury bhi andar.

Ref: Rule 3(1)(z); Rule 3(1); Rule 84
column5: CCS_Pension Rule_03_1_z Definition CCS_Pension::Rule_03 Priority::Medium CCS_Pension::Rule_03_1_z

Rule: FR 1922 is the fallback lexicon for these Rules.

column2: transfer cases are regulated with a{{c1::6-month election window}}under the proviso — explain.
column3:
Rule: On transfer to a post under different pension terms, the servant elects within 6 months (proviso); the transfer-election rule's sub-rule –transfer-election give the processing frame.

Hinglish: Transfer par 6 mahine me chunav karo — kaunsi pension-terms chahiye.

column2: a Government servant shall NOT earn{{c1::two pensions}}in the same service — state the bar.
column3:
Rule: One service = one pension; exceptions only via the civil-return rule or 20 (re-employment counting).

Hinglish: Ek naukri = ek pension; doosri pension sirf Rule civil-return/military-counting se.

Ref: Rule 6(1), 6(2); Rule 6(1); Rule 19; Rule 20

column2: pension/gratuity may be withheld for{{c1::serious crime / grave misconduct}}— who decides, and with what consultation?
